model.description: MEASURED (expert, during the inc-3 deploy): start.mjs step-4 rebuilds on EVERY boot in DEV mode, so prod ships SOURCEMAPS (.map). Pre-existing (NOT caused by inc-3) and deliberately NOT fixed inside a deploy. The prod boot build must run in PRODUCTION mode: no sourcemaps emitted, OR emitted-but-not-served / access-controlled (architect picks the shape). The deterministic pinned-esbuild property and the on-every-boot rebuild are KEPT — do NOT trade determinism away for this. WHY: shipped sourcemaps disclose source structure, which carries MORE WEIGHT in a codebase that has already had a credential exposure (R40.21/R40.22 family).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The prod boot build (start.mjs step-4) runs in PRODUCTION mode: NO sourcemaps emitted, OR emitted-but-NOT-SERVED / access-controlled (architect picks the shape). Prod stops shipping .map on the public served surface.

A GATE asserts NO .map is REACHABLE on the served surface (fetch the served /dist and assert no .map resolves), with STUB-MUST-FAIL: plant a served .map -> assert RED. Served-surface, not build-dir — it is about what prod EXPOSES.

KEEP the deterministic pinned-esbuild property AND the on-every-boot rebuild — do NOT trade determinism (served==committed==build reproducibility) away for this. Production-mode is added, determinism is preserved.

WHY (recorded): shipped sourcemaps DISCLOSE source structure; this carries MORE WEIGHT in a codebase that has already had a credential exposure (R40.21/R40.22). Disclosure-reduction, not a cosmetic build cleanup.
